status: Fixed before any association between role share and any game trait, and before any role-aware variance component, CGE or forecast of E013 was computed on real data. Seen before this freeze: E012's results (listed in the prereg), the player_play alignment vocabulary and counts by Combine position (no trait values), and the unit tests of bdb27.probes.i_role_aware on simulated data. Anything decided after this point is labeled post hoc in E013.json.

choices.choice: Exactly E012's: Combine positions (WR traits use Combine WRs), REG games, chronological order = game_id order, qualifying games and per-game values as stored by E012 (data/processed/e012_game_values.parquet for the internal fit; e012_prospective_values.parquet, built with 2023-24 constants and expectation models, for the prospective test), players with >= 3 qualifying games. Player table = e012_players.parquet (internal: as stored; prospective: the strict 2023-24 Combine composites (__v2) swapped in, as E012 --reuse-values). The 9 traits of the prereg: T1, T2, T3, T5, T6, T7, T9, T11, T12.
choices.reason: Prereg: values, qualifying rules, centering and expectation models exactly as E012, reusing its tables.

choices.choice: Counting unit = one player_play row (REG games) of the player in a game. Every row counts, including plays nullified by penalty (the alignment is a pre-snap fact) and plays that carry no value of the trait (prereg: all plays of the qualifying games). Numerator / denominator alignments exactly as the prereg (WR slot: SLOT_WR / SLOT_WR+WR; DL edge: EDGE+OLB / EDGE+OLB+INTERIOR_LINE; OL tackle: T / T+G+C; DB corner: CB+SLOT_CB / CB+SLOT_CB+HIGH_SAFETY+BOX_SAFETY+OLB+MLB+EDGE+INTERIOR_LINE); null and other alignments ignored. Share = sum numerator / sum denominator over the games (play-weighted); undefined (null) if the denominator is 0, then median-imputed with a missing indicator inside linkage._model (and by i_role_aware.impute_cols in the ANOVA). Data facts seen before this freeze (vocabulary only, no trait values): Combine DL have 51 OLB rows against 28,884 EDGE and 23,030 INTERIOR_LINE (edge share is effectively EDGE / (EDGE + INTERIOR_LINE)); 503 DL rows at SLOT_CB are ignored.
choices.reason: Prereg role_definition; play weighting makes the share the fraction of his snaps in the role.

choices.choice: Internal fit: the player's qualifying games of the trait in e012_game_values (2023-25). Prospective training: his qualifying games of the trait in the train split (2023-24 seasons, 2023-24 classes). In season at k: his first k qualifying 2025 games of the trait (game_id order). Oracle (secondary): all his 2025 qualifying games of the trait. The prereg's 'role share over all of the player's 2023-24 games' is read with its role_definition.source: all plays of the qualifying games used for the trait.

C0 = E012's (draft-year mean within position; the training-fold class mean in CV). C0_role = linkage._model on [draft-year dummies (h_game_equivalents.design, earliest class the reference) | role_share]. C2_role = [dummies | linkage.COMBINE_CONTROLS + linkage.DRAFT_CONTROLS | role_share]. C3_role = [dummies | C2 columns + the tracked-40 set + the trait's matched signature (E012 C3) | role_share]. E012's C2 and C3 are carried in the same estimate (same folds) for reference and reproduction. Role share enters linearly.

h_game_equivalents.estimate on the six sets (draft-year-strata variance components, rel, RepeatedKFold 5 x 20 seed 0 over players, R2_CV = mean over repeats of 1 - MSE / Var_w, R2_true = clip(R2_CV / rel, 0, 0.99), CGE = lambda R2 / (1 - R2) with E012's position-level lambda and rel). role_worth = CGE(C0_role) (E012 formula; like E012's CGE it is measured against the position average); sensitivity: C0-relative under the same CV (E012 PH8 convention). cge_beyond_role(C) = CGE(C) - CGE(C0_role) for C2_role and C3_role (i_role_aware derivation 2: equals lambda_role P / (1 - P) with P the partial true-score R2 beyond role; the unclipped difference of the two clipped CGEs, so it can be negative); tracking beyond C2_role = CGE(C3_role) - CGE(C2_role), descriptive. combine_change_once_role_known = CGE(C2) - cge_beyond_role(C2_role). lambda_role (primary) = sigma2 / tau2_role with tau2_role from the stratified one-way ANOVA with the role covariate (derivation 3, unit-tested against simulation), 'as E012's variance components'; reported beside the CV route lambda / (1 - R2_true(C0_role)) = lambda + CGE(C0_role), which is what the trust rule uses. half_weight_game = lambda / (1 - R2_C) and trust-table weights w_k = k / (k + lambda / (1 - R2_C)) at k = 1, 4, 8 (E012 amendment A1) for C0_role and C2_role, with C0 and C2 beside them; the 2023-24 fit's values (validation training fit) beside the internal ones. Rookie appearances = half-weight / E012's qualifying_share_2025_rookies share (derived, as writeup provenance item 1).
choices.reason: Prereg estimands_descriptive; one estimator family with E012 so differences are attributable to role.

choices.choice: 1,000 player resamples per trait with E012's seeds (20261015 + E012 trait index): the same player draws and per-resample CV seeds as E012's B1, so its C0 / C2 / C3 draws reproduce data/processed/e012_bootstrap.parquet (checked). The whole pipeline (i_role_aware.estimate_role: E012 estimate with grouped folds over the unique resampled players, 20 CV repeats, plus lambda_role) per resample; each player's role share travels with him. 95% percentile intervals (h_game_equivalents.percentile_ci, non-finite draws as +inf). Differences (beyond role, the change once role is known) are computed within each draw. Simulated coverage of these intervals is reported (S2), and they are read as nominal.

E012 PH6 method at each trait's own design (its players, classes, game counts and design matrices; tau2 = 1, no class effects, games iid N(theta, lambda_hat) with the trait's internal lambda; 200 datasets per grid point; seeds default_rng([20261018, family, trait index, grid index, rep])). Neyman one-sided 95% bounds (h_game_equivalents.calibrated_bounds) for the CV estimand (each set's CGE from the mean oracle R2 of its out-of-fold forecasts against theta, clipped at 0), plus the population-signal version. Families: (a) role worth: theta = sqrt(rho) z + sqrt(1 - rho) u, z = standardized role share (median-imputed), rho in (0, .05, .1, .15, .2, .25, .3, .4, .5, .6, .75, .9); sets C0, C0_role; estimate CGE(C0_role); population CGE = lambda rho / (1 - rho). (b) C2 beyond role: theta = sqrt(rho_hat) z + sqrt(1 - rho_hat) (sqrt(g) s_perp + sqrt(1 - g) u), s = signed sum of 3 random columns of the C2 Combine design (h_game_equivalents.signal_matrix), residualized on z and standardized; rho_hat = the trait's observed internal R2_true(C0_role), clipped to [0, 0.95]; g in E012's grid (0 ... 0.75); sets C0, C0_role, C2_role; estimate CGE(C2_role) - CGE(C0_role); estimand CGE*(C2_role) - CGE*(C0_role); population = lambda / (1 - rho_hat) g / (1 - g). (c) C3 beyond role: as (b) with the C3 Combine design and C3_role.
choices.reason: Prereg: 'the simulation-calibrated bounds method' for CGE beyond role; the task asks for it on every descriptive CGE estimand.

choices.choice: At the T1 and T6 designs (E012's coverage designs): 80 simulated datasets each, theta planted at rho_hat (as S1 b) and at the grid g whose family-(b) estimand is closest to the observed C2 beyond-role value; per dataset B1 with 250 resamples x 20 CV repeats (h_game_equivalents.bootstrap); coverage of the 95% intervals for role worth and for C2 beyond role against the CV estimand from those datasets' mean oracle R2 (as E012's coverage_summary). Seeds default_rng([20261018, 99, trait index, dataset]).
choices.reason: LESSONS 2026-10-15: check interval coverage by simulation before trusting any bootstrap.

choices.choice: E012 P1-P4 unchanged: the stored prospective values split by h_game_equivalents.split_prospective (train = 2023-24 seasons of the 2023-24 classes; test = 2025 class, 2025 season); h_game_equivalents.fit_prospective on the six sets (WR traits also the deep-share sets, P6); training role share from 2023-24 qualifying games only; the 2025 prior for a role set = ridge prediction with the draft-year dummy at its training mean and the role share from his first k qualifying 2025 games. Checked at run time: training seasons <= 2024 and classes < 2025; the fit is unchanged when every 2025 alignment is altered; the k-game priors are unchanged when the alignments of games after k are altered; the C0 / C2 / C3 forecast errors equal E012's stored e012_forecasts_2025 rows.
choices.reason: Prereg leakage rules: nothing from 2025 in any fitted quantity; role share in the test from the first k qualifying games only.

choices.choice: h_game_equivalents.in_season_forecasts run separately at each k in 1..4 with that k's role shares (i_role_aware.in_season_role_forecasts): 2025 rookies with >= k + 3 qualifying games; target = mean of games k+1..end; blend = mu_C + w_k (ybar_k - mu_C), w_k = k / (k + lambda / (1 - R2_C)) (E012 A1) with lambda, R2_C and tau2 from the 2023-24 fit; standardized SE = (forecast - target)^2 / tau2_train (position-level). No role prior at k = 0. Pooled = equal-weight mean over the 9 traits with >= 1 eligible player at that k of the trait's mean standardized SE.

H1: se_blend_C0_role vs se_blend_C0 at k = 1; H2: the same at k = 2; H3: se_blend_C2_role vs se_blend_C0_role at k = 1; H4: se_blend_C3_role vs se_blend_C2_role at k = 1. Player-level paired difference d_i = sum over his traits of (SE_a - SE_b) / (T n_t) (E012 P6); one-sided sign-flip test, 100,000 flips, expected sign negative, seeds 20261018 + 1..4; player bootstrap (10,000) 95% CIs for both pooled means, the difference and the ratio; BH across H1-H4 at alpha 0.05; pass = q < 0.05 and difference < 0.

Team of a 2025 rookie = the team_abbr on most of his 2025 REG player_play rows (ties: alphabetical first; none: his own cluster). For every primary and secondary test: sign flips of team sums of d_i (100,000) and a team-cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples of teams, each with all its players) for the difference and the ratio. BH across H1-H4 on the team-cluster p values is reported as a sensitivity; the decision uses the player-level test.
choices.reason: Prereg inference: team-cluster sign flips as a sensitivity (E012 review).

choices.choice: Descriptive tests, each with a player-level one-sided sign-flip p, player-bootstrap CIs and the team-cluster versions; BH across the whole family (player-level p) reported as q_family. (i) per trait (9 x 4): C0_role vs C0 at k = 1 and k = 2, C2_role vs C0_role at k = 1, C3_role vs C2_role at k = 1; (ii) per position (4 x 4): the same four comparisons pooled with equal weight over the position's traits (WR T1/T2/T3/T5, DL T6/T7, OL T9, DB T11/T12); (iii) k = 3 and k = 4 (2 x 3): C0_role vs C0, C2_role vs C0_role, C3_role vs C2_role, pooled; (iv) oracle role (4): H1-H4 with role share from all his 2025 qualifying games (an upper bound: it uses the target games); (v) WR deep-route share (5): deep share (GO/POST/CORNER/WHEEL among routes run, over the same plays as role share; training over 2023-24 qualifying games, test over his first k) appended to every role set for the 4 WR traits: H1-H4 analogues on the WR traits, and C0_role+deep vs C0_role at k = 1. A test runs when >= 3 players are eligible (otherwise n is reported and the test is not in the family). Seeds 20261018 + 1000 + its index in this order.
choices.reason: Prereg secondary list; one fixed family for multiplicity.

choices.choice: Pooled curves at k = 1..4 for games-only, every prior alone and every blend (player-bootstrap 95% CIs, common rows); 80% interval coverage of the C0_role / C2_role / C3_role blends with E012's P7 formula (all quantities from the 2023-24 fit); per-trait mean SEs.

Per trait: role share distribution of the analysis players (mean, quartiles, shares >= 0.9 and <= 0.1, missing); correlation of the first-k role share with the oracle role share for test rookies (k = 1, 2); within-player correlation of per-game role share with per-game trait value (both centred by player; the same-game share of role that the internal fit can carry because role and trait come from the same games); Pearson r of the draft-year-centred player trait with role share; E012's NFL roster-position reference for context.

choices.topic: known design facts (from E012's definitions, not results)
choices.choice: T6 / T7 play values are centred by EDGE / INTERIOR_LINE alignment, T9 by T / G / C, T11 by alignment x coverage cell, and T2 / T3 by route type, so for those traits role share can add only what play-level centring leaves; T1, T5 and T12 are not alignment-centred.
choices.reason: Stated before results so it cannot be used selectively.

choices.choice: joblib n_jobs 3 with one BLAS/OpenMP thread per worker, threadpool_limits(3) at top; bootstrap and simulation checkpoints in the session scratchpad (removed at the end); outputs data/processed/e013_*.parquet (role shares, bootstrap draws, simulation belts, coverage, forecasts), experiments/results/E013.json, experiments/figures/E013_*.png. Figures: per trait, what the position average, the role-aware average and the Combine + draft beyond role are worth in games (B1 intervals, calibrated bounds, E012's CGE(C2) as reference) and the prospective test; layout decided on viewing (post hoc, no numbers).
